rdfs:label: Notification
rdfs:comment: A notification resource — typically an RDF payload delivered to an LDN inbox (ldp:inbox). Optional type; LDN itself does not require notifications to be typed.
notes: Defined in the Solid terms vocabulary simply as a notification resource. Typically POSTed to a `urn:solid:inbox` container per Linked Data Notifications (LDN), which defines no Notification class. The payload is RDF; common shapes use ActivityStreams `as:Activity`. Not the Solid Notifications Protocol (WebSocket/Webhook channel subscriptions).

jsonld.urn:solid:content: Bob wants to share a file with you.

history.note: Definition: optional type for a notification resource, not required by LDN; seeAlso LDN and Solid Notifications Protocol.
